name: Craw's protocol droid
description: For some time, a protocol droid served Craw, the self-titled Dictator-Forever of the planet Targonn. At some point, Craw told a visiting Hardexian ambassador a joke about three Hardex and a bantha. When the ambassador was not amused by the protocol droid's translation of the joke, Craw had the droid deactivated and turned into a fountain. In his new function, the droid's frame stood posed on one leg with both arms outstretched while water flowed from his mouth and birds used the structure as a perch.
